notes.title: PonPonTown Update Log (August 14th)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here are the optimizations, fixes, and new features we completed in the three days following our DEMO release. This update focuses on improving the gaming experience and fixing known issues. Thank you for your support and feedback!


✨ New Content

✅ Changed settings interface save to save game

✅ Added window left-right alignment functionality to settings interface


🔧 Fixed Issues

🛠 Fixed the issue where passing monkey priority was not taking effect

🛠 Renamed Watchtower to Observatory

🛠 Tutorial issue fixes



🧠 Experience Improvements

🔄 Main interface tutorial -> changed to encyclopedia

🔄 Observatory now highlights additional conditions in red

🔄 Tutorial text position adjustments

🔄 Advanced bubbles are no longer affected by durability correction

🔄 Added popup auto-adaptation to ensure text doesn't exceed boundaries

notes.title: PonPonTown - August 7, 2025 Update Log
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here are the optimizations, fixes, and new features we've completed over the past two weeks. This update focuses on preparations for the complete demo, bug fixes, UI art optimization, and animal graphics and effects optimization.



✨ New Features
✅ Settings interface supports free dragging and scaling, supports custom UI font size, supports toggling close-up camera

✅ New shop system, fox shop stocked with various novel and special items

✅ New tavern system

✅ Added DPS statistics panel

✅ New expedition system, dispatch expeditions to earn additional rewards

✅ Tutorial optimization and more beginner guidance

✅ Added special buildings and special NPCs in the forest

✅ Cafeteria R&D added recommended dishes

✅ Game flow organization and optimization

✅ Multi-language support

✅ Watchtower map page design iteration



🧠 Experience Optimization
🔄 UI art optimization iteration for main interface, settings interface, tavern, dormitory, cafeteria, etc.

🔄 Font optimization

🔄 Village added more living animal villagers

🔄 As prosperity increases in the village, there will be more and more villagers and tourists

🔄 Added scene transition graphics

🔄 Hand-click portal performance optimization

🔄 Different base font sizes for different languages

🔄 Village building graphics replacement



🔧 Fixed Issues
🛠 Fixed building save bug

🛠 Tavern animal list sorting

🛠 Forest map manual door refresh position adjustment

🛠 Talent tree panel initial position aligned to center column

🛠 Fixed tutorial not updating

🛠 Fixed issue where only one recipe was selectable when opening cafeteria for the first time

🛠 Fixed memory leak issues

🛠 Fixed sky becoming transparent when camera zooming

🛠 Fixed number carry issues




The DEMO is coming soon, welcome everyone to try it out! Please share your valuable feedback, and all founding shareholders who provide feedback will be added to our acknowledgment list and receive a thank-you PonPon Ball skin when the game launches!

notes.title: PonPonTown-2025/07/18 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here are the optimizations, fixes, and new features we’ve implemented over the past 10 days. This update focuses on improving the new player experience, fixing bugs, and preparing for the full demo release at the end of the month.



✨ New Content

✅ Added a streamlined tutorial

Guides will help new players understand game basics faster. 

✅ Clickable tutorial links

Click tutorial prompts on the main UI to jump directly to relevant upgrade windows.

✅ Optimized village building markers

Added always-visible building name labels to improve clarity (art will be polished later).

✅ Added exit confirmation dialog

Prevents accidental exits with a confirmation prompt.



🔧 Fixes

🛠 Fixed text overflow without line breaks in talent trees.

🛠 Fixed disappearing tutorial images on the main interface.

🛠 Resolved intermittent item selling failures.

🛠 Fixed resource display errors where unlocks failed despite sufficient resources.

🛠 Fixed visual glitches in the launch zone (ball queue now follows camera movement and behaves correctly during screen shake)

🛠 First-time talent tree view now centers on the correct starting node



🧠 Quality-of-Life Improvements

🔄 Removed secondary confirmation for ball upgrades.

🔄 Optimized timing between portal disappearance and ball spawn.

🔄 Owned animals now appear at the top of the dormitory list.

🔄 Replaced "Press F to upgrade" with a dedicated button.

🔄 Refined "New Upgrade Available" notification text.



⚠️ Known Issues (Pending Fixes)

⚠️ Occasional centered window on first launch instead of right-edge snap: Restart game temporarily; fix in progress.

⚠️ Window resizing and free dragging are nearly complete but still under testing — planned for the next version.



🎉 Completed Features (Coming to End-of-Month Demo)

🌳 All collidable objects now have break animations!

Could there be treasure chests inside broken houses?

🗼 Watchtowers now buildable in villages! Explore the world beyond.

Dispatch expeditions with Gold/Silver Seeds for extra rewards!
